label: Week 34, 2026
recap:
This week's US AI policy activity was fairly quiet, with 3 bill movements recorded across 2 jurisdictions, California with 2 and the United States Congress with 1. The themes touched on were government use, appearing twice, and transparency and disclosure, also appearing twice, with California SB1159 cited as an example. Consumer protection and discrimination came up once, tied to United States Congress HB10110, and elections appeared once as well. One bill did not fit into any theme category. Two agencies were referenced in connection with this activity, the Civil Rights Commission and the Commerce Department.

On the litigation side, there were 11 case updates during the week, alongside 2 federal documents. Taken together, the week reflected modest but steady movement, spanning a small number of state and federal bill status chang

federal.title: Solicitation of Nominations for Membership on the NOAA Science Advisory Board (SAB)
federal.detail: The NOAA Science Advisory Board (SAB) is the only Federal Advisory Committee with responsibility to advise the Under Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere on long- and short-range strategies for research, education and the application of science to resource management and environmental assessment and prediction. NOAA seeks candidates with expertise in areas relevant to its mission, including Federal, State, and local government; social and behavioral sciences; artificial intelligence and machine learning; high performance computing; data management, including open access and accessibility; uncrewed systems; whale research and conservation; aircraft systems and modernization; and economic analysis, including cost-benefit evaluation of observing systems. NOAA also encourages nominations of qualified mid-career scientists and engineers.

federal.detail: Notice is hereby given, pursuant to the provisions of the rules and regulations of the U.S. Commission on Civil Rights (Commission) and the Federal Advisory Committee Act, that the Maryland Advisory Committee (Committee) to the Commission will hold a public meeting via Zoom.
